Theora | Analyst-Grade AI for Biopharma top of page THEORA Learn More Backed by We teach AI how real-world medicine is done Datasets and environments to help healthcare agents succeed at complex multi-step tasks grounded in real patient cases A world-class founding team PROBLEM Medicine is not Q&A Today’s AI models can outperform doctors on standardized tests. But they struggle with real medicine: a long chain of decisions, detours, tradeoffs, and context, where judgement errors compound. The training signal for that doesn’t exists on the internet or in papers — but it is a reality in every hospital. CONTEXT Health agents lack a verifiable reward Human feedback made LLMs interactive. Expert reasoning traces made them useful for professional tasks. The biggest capability gains are nonetheless from RL with verifiable rewards, hence why math and coding have improved so quickly. We help agents master valuable healthcare tasks. Learn More 1. Supervised fine-tuning Teaching models how experts reason across multi-step tasks such as navigating PACS, EHR, and multimodal data. 2. Reinforcement learning Expert-crafted rubrics with real-world outcome grounding to generate scalable reward signals across realistic settings. 3. (also doing business as Louiza Labs) (“Louiza,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) collects, uses, and shares information when you visit our website (the “Site”). ​ 1) Information We Collect We collect only the information you choose to provide: Email address (e.g., when you join a waitlist, request updates, or contact us) We do not collect payments, and we do not run ads on the Site. ​ 2) How We Use Your Information We use your email address to: Send product updates, announcements, and requested information Respond to your inquiries Maintain and improve our communications with you ​ 3) How We Share Information We do not sell your personal information. We may share your email address only with: Service providers that help us operate email delivery and website infrastructure (acting on our instructions), and/or Legal or safety reasons if required by law or to protect rights, safety, and security Business transfers if we undergo a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets (your information may be transferred as part of that transaction) ​ 4) Data Retention We keep your email address as long as reasonably necessary to provide updates and communications, unless a longer period is required by law. You may request deletion at any time (see Section 6). ​ 5) Security We use reasonable safeguards designed to protect your information. No method of transmission or storage is fully secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security. ​ 6) Your Choices Unsubscribe: You can opt out of marketing emails at any time by using the unsubscribe link in our emails (if included) or by contacting us. Access / Deletion: You may request access to or deletion of your email by contacting us at larissa@louiza-labs.com ​ 7) Children’s Privacy The Site is not intended for children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children. ​ 8) Changes to This Policy We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Accessibility Statement | Theora top of page Our Commitment to Web Accessibility At My Site, we strive to ensure that our website is inclusive and user-friendly for everyone. We continuously work to enhance the accessibility features of our site, making it easier for individuals with disabilities to access the information and services they need. What Accessibility Means to Us Accessibility is about ensuring that all individuals, regardless of their abilities, can perceive, understand, navigate, and interact with our website. It is our aim to provide a seamless and enjoyable browsing experience for every visitor. Our Accessibility Initiatives We have implemented various measures to enhance the accessibility of our site, aligning with the latest WCAG [2.0 / 2.1 / 2.2] guidelines. Our site is designed to be compatible with assistive technologies, such as screen readers, and to provide a barrier-free experience for all users. Our initiatives include: - Conducting regular accessibility audits to identify and address potential issues - Ensuring proper structuring and labeling of content for easy navigation - Providing alternative text for images to aid understanding - Using color contrasts to improve readability - Minimizing the use of animations and ensuring compatibility with assistive technologies - Ensuring multimedia content is accessible to all users Declaration of partial compliance with the standard due to third-party content [only add if relevant] In some cases, certain pages on our site may depend on third-party content, which may impact their accessibility. We are continuously working to address these issues and achieve full compliance with accessibility standards.
